features.purpose: Let a user record private predictions, resolve them when due, and measure hit rate and calibration.
features.visibility: authenticated; private to the creating user within their organization

routes.description: Dashboard: summary tiles, due preview, and charts
Due-for-review queue, oldest deadline first; results recorded in place
Prediction list following ADR 0017
urlState: status (active|open|due|resolved|void|all; omitted means active = all except void)

routes.description: Sentence-style create form; optional validated returnTo
Prediction detail with claim, reasoning, outcome, amendment history, result history, reasoning history, and lifecycle actions; optional validated returnTo
componentState: record-result, void, restore, and delete dialogs

routes.description: Edit form with grace-window countdown and Amended confirmation; optional validated returnTo
componentState: advisory grace countdown derived from server createdAt

workflow.lifecycle: open -> due -> resolved; void from any state; restore returns previous state; delete only when voided
workflow.subject: active Security Master record, Other symbol (trimmed, uppercased, suggested from the user's history), or topic for Freeform; Event reaction requires a security
workflow.otherSymbolMatch: Non-blocking prompt to use a matching active Security Master record
deadlinePresets: End of week (last trading day of the current Sunday-Saturday week)
End of month (last trading day of the month)
workflow.direction: Rises/Falls with an unsigned move size; derived for Target price and predicted-price input
workflow.priceCapture: Manual; price at prediction and captured-at required for measurable types; predicted price and % both stored; actual price optional at resolution
workflow.priceFormat: No currency symbol; locale decimal input; at least 4 decimal places; greater than zero
workflow.amendRule: Claim edits after 5 minutes require confirmation and mark Amended permanently; server is authoritative
workflow.earlyResolution: Only Correct on Target price or Percent move before the deadline; other types, and Incorrect for any type, show the deadline message
workflow.resultHistory: Changes and clears after the first result are retained; detail shows 'Result changed on {date}'; no badge
workflow.reasoning: Optional free-form text area labelled 'Why do you think this will happen? (optional)', visible by default on create and edit; direct Markdown in a plain textarea, displayed with MarkdownViewer (ADR 0012); saved exactly as typed; not a claim field
workflow.reasoningHistory: Edits after the 5-minute grace window are retained; detail shows 'Reasoning edited on {date}'; no badge; no stats effect
workflow.suggestedResult: Shown only when an actual price is entered; pre-selects only if the user has not chosen

items: hit rate over time (week/month by resolution date)
calibration with n per bucket and sparse note (n < 5); always shown
results by normalized symbol (top 10; table lists all)
charts.colorRules: Correct/Incorrect use a colorblind-safe pair plus icons and patterns; price direction is never colored as good/bad
charts.tone: neutral descriptive copy; no streaks or rankings

features.placeholderNote: Do not add price-lookup or calendar placeholders to the create form; if surfaced later, use NotYetImplemented (ADR 0003) with no API calls

responsiveLayout.desktop: tiles in one row, charts in two columns, one-row filters
responsiveLayout.tablet: charts in one column, two-column filters, wrapping sentence row
responsiveLayout.mobile: stacked cards for due and list rows, single-column form, record result as bottom sheet

accessibilityRequirements: keyboard-operable segmented controls, combobox, slider with numeric input, and dialogs
chart accessibilityLayer plus View as table alternatives
text and icon for status, result, and direction; never color alone
polite announcements for preview, saves, resolutions, and grace-window end; no per-second countdown announcements
focus moves to the next due row after resolving
support zoom/reflow up to 200% and 320px width

appLibraries.components: shadcn/ui primitives (Card, Chart, Table, ToggleGroup, Command, Popover, Calendar, Slider, Dialog, Sheet, AlertDialog, Badge, Alert, Collapsible)

Security edit form; optional validated returnTo preserves list search/filters

detailQueryState: returnTo (validated same-origin Security Master list URL)
createQueryState: returnTo (optional validated same-origin Security Master list URL)
features: search by symbol or name
filter by status, type, and exchange
create, inspect, edit, deactivate, reactivate, and safely delete securities
select Exchange from an optional closed dropdown with blank, NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX, LSE, TSX, and Other choices; users cannot enter custom values

exchangeInputContract.control: native closed select, not an editable combobox
exchangeInputContract.label: Exchange (optional)
exchangeInputContract.choiceScope: Initial convenience set only; not a complete, official, licensed, or authoritative exchange catalog
exchangeInputContract.customValues: Users cannot type or add exchange values; OTHER is a literal value and does not open custom text entry or reference an exchange entity
exchangeInputContract.blankValue: Blank is valid; preserve the existing optional string/null API field and persist blank as no exchange without inventing a default
exchangeInputContract.editing: Use the native select for create and edit; preserve an existing nonblank value outside the choices as a clearly labelled legacy/current option until the user selects a fixed choice
exchangeInputContract.keyboard: Use native select keyboard interaction, including Arrow Up/Down and browser-supported type-to-select; retain visible focus
exchangeInputContract.screenReader: Use a native select with an explicitly associated Exchange (optional) label; do not add custom combobox/listbox ARIA semantics

detailViewContract.header: Show Symbol - Name - Active/Inactive together on one line where space allows; wrap naturally on narrow screens
detailViewContract.layout: Two-column label/value rows; first column contains labels and second column contains values
detailViewContract.labels: Use bold, high-contrast field labels in a compact fixed-width first column with a narrow gap to values
detailViewContract.description: Keep in the value column; preserve user-entered line breaks and wrap long content
detailViewContract.rowFeedback: Subtle background hover highlight for visual row tracking; rows remain read-only, non-clickable, and not in the keyboard tab order
detailViewContract.auditMetadata: Show Created and Updated together at the bottom in smaller secondary text using semantic time elements
detailViewContract.primaryContent: Keep symbol/name identity, status, and record fields before audit metadata

createFormContract.initialState: All fields start blank, including optional Type
createFormContract.staleValues: Do not carry values from a prior create or edit session into a new security form
createFormContract.editLoading: Render the edit form only after the record loads; show distinct loading and failed-load states
createFormContract.validationFeedback: Field-associated errors; focus first invalid field; duplicate identity associated with Symbol/Exchange

workflow.duplicateIdentity: organization + normalized symbol + exchange; blank exchange is a distinct value
workflow.blankExchangeDuplicatePolicy: one blank-exchange record per normalized symbol per organization; may coexist with records for the same symbol having specified exchanges

listViewContract.pageTitle: Use a moderate page-title size; do not let the Security Master title dominate the grid
listViewContract.rowFeedback: Subtle result-row background highlight on hover; retain an explicit View action
listViewContract.countStatus: Muted polite status line below the grid and in the no-results state: 'Showing N of T securities', where N is filtered results and T is the organization's unfiltered total (API totalCount)
listViewContract.createReturnContext: Add security carries the validated list returnTo

filters.wideLayout: Search, Status, Type, and Exchange appear in one row
filters.responsiveLayout: Wrap to two columns on tablet and one column on narrow mobile
filters.exchangeControl: Native select with All exchanges, NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX, LSE, TSX, and OTHER; preserve an unlisted current URL filter as a labelled option
filters.urlContract: Continue to store exchange as the existing string query parameter and send the same API filter

responsiveLayout.desktop: searchable table with visible filters and row actions
responsiveLayout.tablet: responsive table or horizontal overflow; preserve search and filter visibility
responsiveLayout.mobile: single-column list or stacked result cards and single-column forms

accessibilityRequirements: keyboard-accessible search, filters, forms, dialogs, and row actions
visible focus and logical focus return after dialogs
text as well as color for active/inactive status
screen-reader announcements for loading, errors, and mutation results
